loaded_aerodynamic_source_review.scope: Independent source review of the prescribed moving-geometry production interface, finite circulation base, complete circulation and motion forcing, independent load reference, output moments and bounded execution.
conclusions: Fin r0/r1/rm move together; material frames, stations, lengths, physical identities and fixed reference flow are preserved. SurfaceMotion supplies current origins and fin-only physical translation velocity/acceleration with zero angular motion.

Two-degree literal section incidence and zero-degree flight angles are distinct; steady sin/cos tangency is solved independently and checked in production. Full J is linear at zero Gamma rate; production finite-base Gamma is separately reconstructed and guarded.

CP influence includes own bound while hv excludes only its own bound and keeps wakes. Collinear other bound segments are zero only outside their finite segment, with singular receivers rejected. Both source and receiver geometry enter h derivatives.
J=W/U, Q=-D/U, D uses loaded force-point perpendicular speed, and Rh+i*omega*Rv-omega^2*Ra has the correct sign. Zero acceleration in tangency is checked explicitly.
Reference force includes Gamma0 times induced-by-Gamma, moving-field and negative local-velocity increments. Rate lift uses the loaded speed; apparent translation force remains active with lag off.

Per-beam and net moments retain the translated base-force arm exactly once. Circulatory/rate terms use quarter chord; apparent terms use half chord. All six components and all decomposition totals are compared, with independent public aggregate checks.

Separate real/imaginary probes correctly realize h=1, hdot=i*omega and hddot=-omega^2 about the finite base at both widths. Both-surface constant translation has zero velocity/acceleration and checks invariant forces plus shifted moments.

All108 source modules and independent reference origin are guarded. Explicit isolated venv execution resolves the local reference import; supervisor enforces120seconds, one thread and no retry, with child cleanup/reaping.
Declared352 aerodynamic evaluations,40 independent fields and80 small dense solves match the source loops; no network, equilibrium or aircraft-linearization call is present.
limitations: Source review does not imply numerical pass or establish aerodynamic fidelity.
Pure translation does not discriminate rotational force/control-point arm conventions.
The idealized component has no loaded-aircraft structural/free-frame coupling and no original-ASWING or experimental parity claim.
